subject: converting an 'inline' shiny app to an HTML UI app (then an old-school ui.R/server.R app)

messages.author: 4184023bb084c468
messages.subject: converting an 'inline' shiny app to an HTML UI app (then an old-school ui.R/server.R app)
parts:
Hi,

Starting with the basic DataTables application here:

http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#datatables

I wanted to convert this to an app with a custom HTML UI as discussed here:

http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#html-ui

I started with this:


library(shiny)

runApp(list(
  ui = basicPage(
    h2('The mtcars data'),
    dataTableOutput('mytable')
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
    output$mytable = renderDataTable({
      mtcars
    })
  }
))

I ran it and viewed source in my browser. That gave me the following, which I saved as www/index.html:



<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8"/>
  <script src="shared/jquery.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
  <script src="shared/shiny.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
  <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="shared/shiny.css"/>
  <script type="application/shiny-singletons">c744daa6a6263cf809ca22847eeba41aa9806e29</script>
  <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="shared/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css"/>
  <script src="shared/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.min.js"></script>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="shared/bootstrap/css/bootstrap-responsive.min.css"/>
  <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="shared/datatables/css/DT_bootstrap.css"/>
  <script src="shared/datatables/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
  <script src="shared/datatables/js/DT_bootstrap.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container-fluid">
  <h2>The mtcars data</h2>
  <div id="mytable" class="shiny-datatable-output"></div>
</div>
</body>
</html>

Then I took the original app and saved just the server part as server.R, wrapped in shinyServer():

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    output$mytable = renderDataTable({
      mtcars
    })
  })

Then I tried the following:

library(shiny)
runApp('.')

I got this error:


Listening on http://127.0.0.1:7653

Error in handler(req) : 

  argument "metaHandler" is missing, with no default

Error in handler(req) : 

  argument "metaHandler" is missing, with no default


Then I tried getting rid of www/index.html and creating a ui.R:

basicPage(
    h2('The mtcars data'),
    dataTableOutput('mytable')
  )

Invoking this:

library(shiny)
runApp('.')

gave me the same error:

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:3758

Error in handler(req) : 

  argument "metaHandler" is missing, with no default

Error in handler(req) : 

  argument "metaHandler" is missing, with no default



What am I doing wrong?

For some context what I am trying to do is run the basic table example but I want more control over what appears in the <head> tag of the generated HTML; I'd like to replace the jquery and datatables js and css files with more recent versions, and add an additional javascript to be sourced. 

Can I do this with tag() and/or tagList()? If so how? It's important that I be able to totally replace the contents of the generated <head> tag with my own, not just add my own.

If I can do this from R I'd prefer that to using a custom HTML UI page.

Thanks,
Dan

messages.subject: Re: converting an 'inline' shiny app to an HTML UI app (then an old-school ui.R/server.R app)
parts:
)

You need to wrap your ui.R code inside a shinyUI()

Did you put your index.html inside the www folder? You need to create a folder www and put your index.html in there. Your folder structure should look like

server.R
www --
         |
       ---- index.html

also check out tags$script singleton for including scripts. e.g. 
singleton(
  tags$head(
    tags$script(
      path_to_your_script
    )
  )
)
